summary: Low: ca-certificates bug fix and enhancement update
details:
The ca-certificates package contains a set of Certificate Authority (CA) certificates chosen by the Mozilla Foundation for use with the Internet Public Key Infrastructure (PKI).

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* Annual 2024 ca-certificates update version 2.69 from NSS 3.101.1 for Firefox 128 [almalinux-8.10] (JIRA:AlmaLinux-44949)
* ca-certificates: python-certifi: Removal of e-Tugra root certificate [almalinux-8.10.0.z] (JIRA:AlmaLinux-16194)
